item.coloph: ces brda yi bshad pa baiDalar+Ya yi gur khang don gsal nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ dam pa kun grol grags pa'i zhal ras nas bdag gis brda bshad 'bru rang sde phyogs bsgrigs gyis shig pa dang*/ nye bar rlung sems byan chud shes rab blo ldan gyis bskul phyir/ smon rgyal sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang bdag gis/ mnyam med rgyal ba ston pa gshen rab mi bo sku 'khrungs nas mi lo nyi khri chig stong bzhi brgya go dgu song zhing / shing pho stag gi lo la bod 'dir g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa 'byung zhing gshen snang ba mdog can dang rgyal po gnya' khri btsad po gnyis byon nas mi lo chig khri bzhi stong chig brgya nyer dgu 'das la/ me mo sbral la gshen chen po klu dga' bas bon gter drangs shing bstan pa bar dar gyi dbu zug nas/ mi lo drug brgya nyer drug song zhing chu lug zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga la bris pa 'dis/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyams med srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur nas 'gro rnams rdzogs ldan gsar ba la dus rtag tu spyod par gyur cig/
